Embedded Software Engineer - Student Position

About the role
Join the networking team and build firmware for our SmartNICs. You will write drivers in C and work closely with the hardware team.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and debug firmware features
- Work with Rust prototypes from the research team

Requirements:
- B.Sc. student in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering, at least 2 years left
- Strong C/C++ programming skills
- Experience with Linux kernel development
- Knowledge of networking protocols
- Familiarity with Python - an advantage

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- Experience with Wireshark

What we offer
- Flexible hours around your studies
